narrative.details:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
narrative.objectives: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, Vanyel.
narrative.requestItemsText: What is it you bring me, champion?

quests.objectiveText: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.

quests.name: Grim Tidings
quests.objectiveText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Brave Wildrunner in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: Our Ancient Enemy
quests.objectiveText: Bring Longwalker Malah's Report to Baine Bloodhoof.

quests.name: Drive Them Out
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Galak Centaurs, 4 Galak Outrunners, and bring the head of Herak the Pillager to Baine Bloodhoof.

quests.name: The High Chieftain
quests.objectiveText: Seek audience with High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
